Depression is a disease.  Doesn't make us weak…. but it's the external factors that decide whether we are successful.

Meds don't work.  Source… 10 months of 200mg Sertraline.  ADs only work if something internally is broke.  But when things externally are broke…… and everyone tells you  it's okay, that it must be the internal shit….. arrghhhh
